newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VEGA SIGNS FOR TOTTENHAM IN $3.7 MILLION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VEGA SIGNS FOR TOTTENHAM IN $3.7 MILLION DEAL.

text.p: England premier league Tottenham signed Swiss international defender Ramon Vega from Italian club Cagliari on Tuesday to take their spending in little more than a month to over nine million pounds($15.2 million).
Vega, 25, signed a four-and-a-half-year contract with the London club after they agreed a 3.7 million pounds ($6.29 million) fee with the Italian side.
Vega's arrival follows the captures of Steffen Iversen and John Scales in the past few weeks.
Tottenham boss Gerry Francis said: "This shows we've got ambition.
"One thing you need at this level is a big squad. We haven't had that for a number of years but now we've started to get in a position where we have got a strong squad.

"It would have been nice if we could have had him at the start of the season but if you really want players you have to keep at it. We've kept wheeling and dealing and we are determined enough to show that we want to challenge the top teams for honours."
Vega, who said that Francis' words had swayed him to ignore attempts by fellow premier league side Leeds to land his services, added: "I am very pleased to be joining one of the best teams in Europe.
"I had a very good six months in Italy but it's a real pleasure for me to play for Spurs. It's the biggest club I've ever played for."
